title: Matsyanyaya Period Before Pala Rise
subtitle: Political fragmentation and conflict before Pala consolidation.
summary: Before the rise of the Pala dynasty, parts of Bengal experienced prolonged instability often described as Matsyanyaya, where fragmented authority, local warfare, and weak centralized rule disrupted social order.
heroTagline: Political fragmentation and conflict before Pala consolidation.
whyItMatters: This phase explains why later political actors prioritized order-building and why the Pala formation was seen as a stabilizing transformation in early medieval Bengal.
